title: Revert binding
description: The jsonb text basalt_meta.prepare_revert builds. The WebAuthn challenge is sha256 of its UTF-8 bytes. Clients parse it for display and never re-serialise it. See CONTRACT.md, Revert.

scopeId.description: The changeId, runId or taskId the scope names.

agents.description: Agent roles whose changes are in scope, sorted.

intent.description: Why the person reverts; recorded as the revert change's intent.

rows.description: RESTORE lines. With rows plus skipped over 1000 the plan is batched.

rowsHash.description: Lowercase hex sha256 of every line, RESTORE and SKIP, joined by a newline.

expiresAt.description: RFC 3339 UTC with microseconds, 1 hour after prepare_revert.

requestedBy.description: The role that called prepare_revert; lines are redacted for it. For a batched plan, the only role that may apply it.

batched.description: Present only on a large plan (more than 1000 lines): the agent applies it in batches of up to 200 lines within 24 hours of the signature.

sampleHash.description: Present only with batched: lowercase hex sha256 of the sample (the first 1000 lines, SKIP lines first, each group in signed order) joined by a newline. The revert request carries the sample.
